subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: What permanent plugin contract should OpenClaw support for hook-triggered session resets after compaction?
rationale: This PR creates a compatibility-sensitive plugin API and also adds automatic runtime reset policy; source inspection cannot determine whether maintainers intend to ship the legacy explicit-key overload or implicit terminal-overflow resets.

options.title: Ship a scoped reason-only API
options.body: Expose resetSession("new" | "reset") only for successful after-compaction hooks with lifecycle-owned deferred execution, and remove the legacy-key and automatic tool-loop policies from this PR.

options.title: Adopt the broader compatibility contract
options.body: Keep the explicit-key overload and terminal-overflow reset behavior, accepting the larger long-term compatibility and session-state surface with dedicated upgrade documentation and proof.

options.title: Keep reset ownership internal
options.body: Do not add a public hook API yet; implement only an internal owner-specific recovery path until the plugin contract is designed separately.

recommendation.title: Ship a scoped reason-only API
recommendation.body: Expose resetSession("new" | "reset") only for successful after-compaction hooks with lifecycle-owned deferred execution, and remove the legacy-key and automatic tool-loop policies from this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history owns the central plugin hook type and dispatch surfaces affected by the new public contract.
